items.title: Should Boston Scientific (BSX) Investors Worry About These FDA Class II Recalls?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (NYSE:BSX) reported multiple FDA-listed Class II recalls of its Neuromodulation system and Direxion Torqueable Microcatheters in 2026.
